svg.title: Mass spectrum retrieval: identify a molecule from its fragmentation spectrum
svg.desc: A real MassSpecGym validation spectrum, three actual candidate molecules, and an archived GLACIER ranking. The true molecule is ranked twenty-second of 256, illustrating the challenge of molecular identification. No test data or synthetic prediction is displayed.

g.text: Identify a molecule from its fragmentation spectrum
Different molecular structures can share nearly the same mass. MS/MS fragments help distinguish them.
Candidate IDs label structures, not model scores.
True structure ranks 22 / 256: a retrieval error.
One example; not an estimate of overall performance.
Accurate molecular identification supports metabolomics, chemical analysis, and the discovery of unknown small molecules.
Benchmark scope: rank supplied, mass-compatible structures from MS/MS data; the primary metric is exact-candidate Hit@1.
Example: MassSpecGymID0079471 (validation). Source: MassSpecGym developers, 2024, MIT. Molecules and ranking are real; see example.json for provenance.
